description: This file defines the Category model class for the OpenCart platform, including methods to retrieve categories, filters, and layout information from the database.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Model class for handling category data interactions with the database within the Opencart catalog module.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a single category record based on the provided category ID.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves multiple categories that have a specific parent ID, defaulting to root categories.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Obtains filter details associated with a specific category, including filter groups and individual filters.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID assigned to a specific category, returning 0 if none is assigned.
